title: COSHUMA affiliate application batch for all eligible registered tools

payload.goal: After the full affiliate audit finishes, apply to EVERY legitimate zero-cost affiliate/referral/partner program available for currently registered COSHUMA tools, not merely a priority subset, so every monetizable catalog entry is taken as far as possible.
requirements: Use the completed Princess full-catalog audit result as the source of truth for candidates and official application links.
Process ALL eligible program_exists_not_applied candidates. Priority only controls order; do not stop after a fixed number.
Skip only already approved, already pending, active rejection/cooldown, closed, paid-to-join, unavailable by eligibility, or duplicate programs, while recording the exact reason.
For each free application, open the actual application page and fill every field that can be safely completed from existing COSHUMA/business/account context.

If CAPTCHA, payment approval, legal consent, OTP, forced human verification, or another genuinely human-only step appears, leave only that step for the user, keep the relevant page prepared/open when supported, mark that individual program waiting_human, and CONTINUE processing other non-blocked programs rather than stopping the whole batch.
Use existing COSHUMA business identity/profile information already available in browser/account context; do not ask the user for data that is already known or retrievable.
For each program record submitted/pending/approved/blocked/waiting_human status, official application URL, network/provider, next expected event, and whether a unique tracking link is issued.
When a unique tracking/referral link is issued, verify that it is actually referral-bearing, then return it for COSHUMA repo integration. Generic homepage/pricing/signup URLs do not qualify.
Do not spend money, start paid subscriptions, or make purchases.

dependency_resolution.duplicate_application_guard: Reuse the audit's 98 deduplicated application actions and authoritative per-tool states. Do not resubmit approved, pending, rejected/cooldown, closed, cost-gated, region-restricted, waiting-human, in-progress, or shared-program duplicates.
dependency_resolution.execution_note: The dependency is cleared. Keep this batch todo until a browser-capable Butler execution surface actually starts processing applications; do not mark in_progress merely because research finished.
